text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document 
outlines the inspection checklist I2, which 
must be carried out on a weekly bases 
as indicated by W1 in the above title block.
The 
first draft has been 
initiated by eng. El-Sayed 
Abdel Moneam El-Geddawy and 
tested at 10 April 02 for T1 at Sheraton El Matar 66kv Substation, Cairo zone.
This document will be implemented 
whereas the transformer is in service.
Safety 
Precaution
Wearing safety helmet, and safety shoes
 is necessary
Work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category
Safety rope with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area must be used,
Tools and Equipment
Suitable tool sets,
Safety helmet and safety shoes
Work to be carried out
Check conservator valves (open)
Check the oil level in conservator and its correspondence 
 with the temperature
Check radiator valves (open)
Check oil sampling valves (closed)
Check the earthing and earthing system
Check the condition of silica-gel and the oil in the 
 air-dehydrator
Check thermometer recordings
Check the condition of the cooling system and fans
Check the main tank, oil leakage and general condition of 
 it
